sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin and I'm Mark Ronson and welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰，我是马克·罗森，欢迎收听《重构者》，一档专注于设计之美及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl,
sentences.zh: 甚至早在黑胶唱片时代的夜总会当DJ时，

sentences.en: every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you and you turned a DJ booth into this like living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 你每晚都要带着300件最珍贵的宝贝去上班，把DJ台变成一个犹如充满美丽50年历史文物的流动快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听爱彼带来的《重构者》。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today, the top-secret creation and stunningly fast implosion of the billion-dollar European Super League and what it may tell us about the future of the world's biggest sport.
sentences.zh: 今天，价值十亿美元的欧洲超级联赛的最高机密创建及其令人咋滑的迅速崩溃，以及它可能向我们透露的关于世界第一大运动未来的信息。

sentences.en: Asted Herndon spoke with our colleague, chief soccer reporter, Rory Smith.
sentences.zh: 阿斯蒂德·赫恩登与我们的同事、首席足球记者罗里·史密斯进行了交谈。

sentences.en: It's Friday, April 23rd.
sentences.zh: 今天是4月23日，星期五。

sentences.en: Rory, how are you?
sentences.zh: 罗里，你好吗？

sentences.en: I'm very well.
sentences.zh: 我很好。

sentences.en: How are you?
sentences.zh: 你好吗？

sentences.en: I am excited for this conversation, Rory, partly because I've been following your work for a long time.
sentences.zh: 罗里，我对这次对话感到很兴奋，部分原因是我关注你的作品很久了。

sentences.en: And also, I just think it's going to be a great introduction for folks who may not be familiar with it.
sentences.zh: 而且我也觉得，对于可能还不太熟悉它的人来说，这将是一个很好的介绍。

sentences.en: We should start off by saying throughout this whole thing, I'm going to call it soccer.
sentences.zh: 我们首先应该说明，在整个采访中，我把它叫做 soccer（英式足球）。

sentences.en: You're going to call it football.
sentences.zh: 你把它叫做 football。

sentences.en: But I know that you can see, I know you can see past that and love me anyway.
sentences.zh: 但我知道你能理解，我知道你能看开这一点，无论如何都会喜欢我。

sentences.en: So I'll call it soccer because I'm so used to writing in time style that I now use it interchangeably, which really annoys most of my friends.
sentences.zh: 所以我还是叫它 soccer，因为我太习惯用时代杂志的风格了，以至于我现在可以交替使用它，这真的让我的大多数朋友很恼火。

sentences.en: But that whole thing is like a weird European pretension because we called it soccer until the 1970s.
sentences.zh: 但整件事其实有点奇怪的欧洲装腔作势，因为直到20世纪70年代我们都叫它 soccer。

sentences.en: It was interchangeable until the 1970s.
sentences.zh: 直到20世纪70年代这两个词都是可以互换的。

sentences.en: I had no idea.
sentences.zh: 我完全不知道。

sentences.en: Really?
sentences.zh: 真的吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: My dad calls it soccer because he's obviously old.
sentences.zh: 我爸爸就叫它 soccer，因为他显然老了。

sentences.en: You know, I think that this has been a week that I know in soccer universe has been the biggest week in a very long time.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我觉得在足球世界里，这周绝对是好长一段时间以来最重大的一周。

sentences.en: It seems as if we should start from the very, very beginning.
sentences.zh: 我们似乎应该从最最开始的地方说起。

sentences.en: Can you just explain to us how the structures of European soccer and from a basic level, how does the sport work?
sentences.zh: 你能给我们解释一下欧洲足球的结构，以及从基础层面来看，这项运动是如何运作的吗？

sentences.en: So the bedrock of all soccer competitions are the domestic national leads.
sentences.zh: 所以，所有足球比赛的基石都是国内国家联赛。

sentences.en: So you have the premier lead in England, La Liga in Spain, Serie A in Italy, the Bundesliga in Germany and equivalents in every single country, not just in Europe,
sentences.zh: 所以你有英格兰的超级联赛、西班牙的西甲联赛、意大利的意甲联赛、德国的德甲联赛，以及每一个国家的同类赛事，不仅仅是在欧洲，

sentences.en: but around the world, effectively.
sentences.zh: 实际上可以说是遍布全球。

sentences.en: They are the drivers of the game, the engine of the game in a way.
sentences.zh: 在某种程度上，它们是比赛的驱动力，是比赛的引擎。

sentences.en: That is where, you know, on a week by week basis, generations of fans have laughed and cried and danced and commiserated.
sentences.zh: 那是世代球迷们周复一周地欢笑、哭泣、狂欢和倾诉的地方。

sentences.en: That's where the popularity of the game is really rooted in a very European sense.
sentences.zh: 从非常浓厚的欧洲意义上讲，这项运动的普及度正是根植于此。

sentences.en: And then on top of that, you have the Champions League, which is a pan continental competition Europe wide, which includes not just the champions, as the name would suggest,
sentences.zh: 而在那之上，你有欧冠联赛，这是一项跨欧洲大陆的全欧赛事，正如其名，它不仅包括冠军球队，

sentences.en: but the teams who finish in second, third and fourth of the domestic leads every season.
sentences.zh: 还包括每个赛季在国内联赛中获得第二、第三和第四名的球队。

sentences.en: So you kind of have this twin track for the elite clubs.
sentences.zh: 所以对于精英俱乐部来说，你基本上有了这样一条双轨制。

sentences.en: They're trying to win the domestic lead as well as the champions lead most years.
sentences.zh: 多数年份里，他们既在努力赢得国内联赛，也在争取欧冠联赛。

sentences.en: And for fans, you kind of get two shots at glory, I guess.
sentences.zh: 我想，对于球迷来说，你基本上有两次争夺荣耀的机会。

sentences.en: So for the best teams, there are two competitions happening at the same time.
sentences.zh: 因此，对于最好的球队来说，同时有两项赛事在进行。

sentences.en: There's a domestic leagues where they're playing against other teams within their own country.
sentences.zh: 一个是国内联赛，他们与自己国家的其他球队比赛。

sentences.en: And then there's the elite competition where they're playing against other teams across the European continent.
sentences.zh: 另一个是精英赛事，他们与整个欧洲大陆的其他球队比赛。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And I guess that in a logical sense, if you kind of conceive of soccer as an entertainment business, the Champions League would be the one that you would care about the moSt.
sentences.zh: 我想从逻辑的角度来看，如果你把足球看作是一项娱乐生意，欧冠联赛会是你最关心的那一个。

sentences.en: But that doesn't necessarily hold true because fans are incredibly attached to their domestic leads.
sentences.zh: 但情况并非总是如此，因为球迷对他们的国内联赛有着难以割舍的感情。

sentences.en: You know, you're talking about competitions that have, in the case of England,
sentences.zh: 你知道，你所谈论的这些赛事，以英格兰为例，

sentences.en: 130 years of history that date back beyond people's grandparents and great grandparents to another generation still.
sentences.zh: 有着130年的历史，可以追溯到人们的祖父母和曾祖父母之前的更早一代人。

sentences.en: I'm a Liverpool fan.
sentences.zh: 我是利物浦球迷。

sentences.en: I was cursed to be a Liverpool fan by my family who, as I was growing up, made it very clear that I have literally no choice about it.
sentences.zh: 我被我的家人诅咒成了一个利物浦球迷，在我成长过程中，他们非常明确地告诉我，我对此根本没有选择的余地。

sentences.en: And the key thing is that fans really feel their team is part of them.
sentences.zh: 关键在于，球迷们真的觉得他们的球队是他们自己的一部分。

sentences.en: So I'm a Tottenham Hotspur fan, an underachieving team in London.
sentences.zh: 所以我是托特纳姆热刺的球迷，一支在伦敦表现未达预期的球队。

sentences.en: And part of what drew me to them was the passion of the local fans that you're talking about.
sentences.zh: 吸引我加入其中的部分原因，正是你所谈论的当地球迷的热情。

sentences.en: That 130 years of history and rivalry.
sentences.zh: 那130年的历史和宿敌对决。

sentences.en: Do you think that it's the strength of those local rivalries that has made the fan connection to the game so intense?
sentences.zh: 你认为正是这些当地死敌之间的激烈竞争，才让球迷与这项运动产生了如此深厚的联系吗？

sentences.en: I think it's the history, but it's also the nature of the clubs themselves, which are social and cultural and community institutions.
sentences.zh: 我认为是历史，但也是俱乐部本身的性质，它们是社会、文化和社区机构。

sentences.en: A lot of them grew out of church teams initially.
sentences.zh: 它们最初很多都是由教堂球队发展而来的。

sentences.en: They were initially founded to give wayward Victorian boys something to do in the absence of any other options in 19th century England.
sentences.zh: 它们最初成立的目的是在19世纪英格兰没有任何其他选择的情况下，给误入歧途的维多利亚时代男孩找点事情做。

sentences.en: A lot of them are rooted around industrial communities or working men's clubs or social groups, particularly around heavy industries.
sentences.zh: 它们很多都扎根于工业社区、工人俱乐部或社会团体，特别是围绕着重工业的群体。

sentences.en: So Manchester United, possibly the most famous club in the world, were founded by workers on the railway.
sentences.zh: 比如曼联，可能是世界上最著名的俱乐部，是由铁路工人创立的。

sentences.en: Arsenal in London were founded by people at the Woolwich Armaments Factory.
sentences.zh: 伦敦的阿森纳是由伍尔维奇兵工厂的人创立的。

sentences.en: It was very specific routes in very specific communities, the clubs.
sentences.zh: 这些俱乐部在特定的社区有着非常具体的根基。

sentences.en: And that, I think, is what people see when they see their club.
sentences.zh: 我想，这就是人们在看到自己的俱乐部时所看到的东西。

sentences.en: That even now, when soccer is this huge global entertainment complex, to a lot of people, their club is their place, it's their home, and it's their community.
sentences.zh: 以至于现在，当足球已经成为一个巨大的全球娱乐综合体时，对许多人来说，他们的俱乐部就是他们的港湾，是他们的家，是他们的社区。

sentences.en: The way you're talking about soccer feels so local.
sentences.zh: 你谈论足球的方式让人感觉非常本土化。

sentences.en: But we know that soccer is also this global business, as you mentioned.
sentences.zh: 但正如你所提到的，我们也知道足球同时也是一项全球性的商业生意。

sentences.en: When and how did that transition start happening?
sentences.zh: 这种转变是什么时候以及如何开始发生的？

sentences.en: Well, soccer's always been international.
sentences.zh: 嗯，足球一直都是国际化的。

sentences.en: It's always been the world's game.
sentences.zh: 它一直是世界的运动。

sentences.en: It was exported around the planet, essentially by the English, in the late 19th century.
sentences.zh: 它基本上是在19世纪末由英国人出口到全世界的。

sentences.en: But the growth of the game, I guess, has two or three major leaps.
sentences.zh: 但这项运动的发展，我想经历了两到三次重大跨越。

sentences.en: Soccer was pretty much the same from maybe the 1880s until the mid-1970s.
sentences.zh: 从18世纪80年代（注：原文1880s）到20世纪70年代中期，足球基本上都是一样的。

sentences.en: The shorts were a little bit shorter, the haircuts had changed, and there'd been one or two kind of tweaks to the rules.
sentences.zh: 短裤稍微短了一点，发型变了，规则有过一两次微调。

sentences.en: But it was a recognisable endeavour.
sentences.zh: 但它是一项辨识度很高的事业。

sentences.en: And then in the 1970s, things start to change a little bit.
sentences.zh: 然后到了20世纪70年代，事情开始发生了一点变化。

sentences.en: So, first of all, sponsorship arrives.
sentences.zh: 首先，赞助商出现了。

sentences.en: You start to see the first teams who have logos emblazoned on their jerseys, selling tyres or cars or electronic goods.
sentences.zh: 你开始看到第一批球衣上印有徽标的球队，用来销售轮胎、汽车或电子产品。

sentences.en: And then you end up with...
sentences.zh: 然后你最后会发现……

sentences.en: The eyes of the world will be focused on Tottenham against Coventry today.
sentences.zh: 今天全世界的目光都将聚焦于热刺对阵考文垂的比赛。

sentences.en: Increased involvement of television as a way of reaching more communities, more fans.
sentences.zh: 电视参与度的提高，成为触及更多社区、更多球迷的途径。

sentences.en: And TV pictures of this oldest of all football cup competitions will be beamed to every corner of the globe.
sentences.zh: 而这项历史最悠久的足球杯赛的电视画面将被传送到全球的每一个角落。

sentences.en: And then at the start of the 1990s, we get soccer's big bang.
sentences.zh: 然后到了20世纪90年代初，我们迎来了足球的宇宙大爆炸。

sentences.en: Sky Sports proudly presents FA Premier League Football for Super Sunday.
sentences.zh: 天空体育自豪地呈现超级星期天英超联赛。

sentences.en: Which is, in 1992, what was the English First Division, the top league in England, is rebranded as the Premier League.
sentences.zh: 也就是说，在1992年，原本的英格兰甲级联赛——英格兰顶级联赛，被更名为英超联赛。

sentences.en: What was the European Cup is rebranded as the Champions League.
sentences.zh: 原本的欧洲俱乐部冠军杯被更名为欧冠联赛。

sentences.en: And soccer enters its modern age.
sentences.zh: 足球进入了它的现代时期。

sentences.en: That brings with it vastly inflated broadcasting deals.
sentences.zh: 这带来了极度膨胀的转播交易。

sentences.en: Vodafone are to step in as United's major sponsors.
sentences.zh: 沃达丰将介入成为曼联的主要赞助商。

sentences.en: It brings with it a glut of sponsorship.
sentences.zh: 这带来了大量的赞助。

sentences.en: An amazing £30 million invested in the club over the next four years.
sentences.zh: 惊人的3000万英镑在接下来的四年里投入到俱乐部中。

sentences.en: And you start to see the first kind of celebrity players.
sentences.zh: 然后你开始看到第一批明星球员。

sentences.en: So you have David Beckham.
sentences.zh: 所以你有了大卫·贝克汉姆。

sentences.en: Please big it up for the main couple in England.
sentences.zh: 请为英格兰这对金童玉女大声喝彩。

sentences.en: Posh and Bex.
sentences.zh: 辣妹与贝克斯。

sentences.en: Who becomes this kind of icon, not only of soccer, but of fashion and pop culture.
sentences.zh: 他成为了这样一种偶像，不仅是足球的偶像，也是时尚和流行文化的偶像。

sentences.en: What's your favourite item of clothing?
sentences.zh: 你最喜欢的衣物是什么？

sentences.en: Favourite item of clothing?
sentences.zh: 最喜欢的衣物？

sentences.en: I don't know, it varies.
sentences.zh: 我不知道，这经常变。

sentences.en: You know, I've got a new shirt that I haven't worn yet.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我有一件新衬衫还没穿过。

sentences.en: You have a Brazilian striker called Ronaldo.
sentences.zh: 你有一个叫罗纳尔多的巴西前锋。

sentences.en: Who becomes the poster boy for Nike.
sentences.zh: 他成为了耐克的活招牌。

sentences.en: Almost overnight, soccer starts to realise its own power, its own popularity.
sentences.zh: 几乎是一夜之间，足球开始意识到它自己的力量、它自己的受欢迎程度。

sentences.en: And you start to see the first shoots of a sport that's starting to think globally, rather than just about its local or at most national context.
sentences.zh: 然后你开始看到一项运动的最初苗头，它开始进行全球化思考，而不仅仅局限于其本土或最多国家范围的背景。

sentences.en: You know, I think about these moments in terms of my own life.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我结合我自己的生活来思考这些时刻。

sentences.en: I started playing FIFA, the soccer video game, as my entry point to the sport.
sentences.zh: 我开始玩FIFA这款足球电子游戏，以此作为我进入这项运动的切入点。

sentences.en: And I think a lot of Americans, we were part of that growth and expansion of soccer's reach.
sentences.zh: 我想很多美国人，我们也是足球影响力增长和扩张的一部分。

sentences.en: You called it soccer realising its own power.
sentences.zh: 你刚才说足球意识到了它自己的力量。

sentences.en: But are you really saying that soccer realised the money it could make?
sentences.zh: 但你真的是在说足球意识到了它能赚多少钱吗？

sentences.en: Probably, yeah.
sentences.zh: 大概是的，对吧。

sentences.en: Power is maybe a euphemism for money.
sentences.zh: 力量也许是金钱的委婉说法。

sentences.en: I don't think the growth of soccer was driven by philanthropy or a love for the game or a desire to evangelise.
sentences.zh: 我不认为足球的发展是由慈善事业、对比赛的热爱或传教的热情所驱动的。

sentences.en: I think it was the result of the Leeds and the clubs, particularly in England, realising that there was money to be made on new frontiers.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是利兹联以及各家俱乐部（尤其是英格兰的俱乐部）意识到在新领域可以赚钱的结果。

sentences.en: So if that's the 90s, what comes next in the 2000s?
sentences.zh: 那么如果那是90年代，2000年代接下来会发生什么？

sentences.en: The same thing, but really souped up and hyper-accelerated.
sentences.zh: 同样的事情，但被真正强化并极速加速了。

sentences.en: And soccer effectively becomes completely unmoored from its previous reality.
sentences.zh: 而且足球实际上与它先前的现实完全脱节了。

sentences.en: So there's kind of three stages, I guess.
sentences.zh: 所以我想大概有三个阶段。

sentences.en: In 2003, Roman Abramovich, a Russian oligarch, one of the beneficiaries of the privatisation of Russian resources after communism, buys Chelsea, an English team.
sentences.zh: 在2003年，罗曼·阿布拉莫维奇，一个俄罗斯寡头，共产主义解体后俄罗斯资源私有化的受益者之一，买下了切尔西这家英格兰球队。

sentences.en: And when he arrives, he spends money in the transfer market, the space where players are bought from other teams, in a way that we hadn't really seen before.
sentences.zh: 当他到来时，他在转会市场——即从其他球队购买球员的领域——上大把花钱，这种方式是我们以前从未见过的。

sentences.en: It was fairly unprecedented.
sentences.zh: 这相当史无前例。

sentences.en: And that heralds the age of super money within soccer.
sentences.zh: 这预示着足球超级金元时代的到来。

sentences.en: So in 2005, the Glazer family, who own the Tampa Bay Buccaneers of the NFL,
sentences.zh: 所以在2005年，拥有NFL坦帕湾海盗队的格雷泽家族，

sentences.en: they buy Manchester United, the most famous club in England, arguably the most important club in the world.
sentences.zh: 他们买下了曼联，英格兰最著名的俱乐部，可以说是世界上最重要的俱乐部。

sentences.en: And pretty soon afterwards, Liverpool takes on American ownership.
sentences.zh: 紧随其后不久，利物浦迎来了美国老板。

sentences.en: Arsenal takes on American ownership.
sentences.zh: 阿森纳迎来了美国老板。

sentences.en: Half a dozen other clubs in England over the next sort of 10 or 15 years will be acquired by American owners.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的大约10到15年里，英格兰还有另外半打俱乐部将被美国老板收购。

sentences.en: And on continental Europe, you have the grand old houses, you have Real Madrid, Barcelona, Juventus in Italy,
sentences.zh: 而在欧洲大陆，你有那些伟大的老牌豪门，你有皇家马德里、巴塞罗那、意大利的尤文图斯，

sentences.en: Bayern Munich in Germany, who are all trying to compete with the money washing into the Premier League, trying to keep up.
sentences.zh: 德国的拜仁慕尼黑，他们都在试图与涌入英超的金钱竞争，试图跟上步伐。

sentences.en: And then in 2008, Manchester City is taken over by Sheikh Mansour bin Zayed, who is the Deputy Prime Minister of Abu Dhabi, the Gulf state.
sentences.zh: 然后在2008年，曼城被曼苏尔·本·扎耶德谢赫接管，他是海湾国家阿布扎比的副首相。

sentences.en: And the whole thing takes on another leap.
sentences.zh: 整个事情实现了又一次飞跃。

sentences.en: Sheikh Mansour is officially the owner of Manchester City.
sentences.zh: 曼苏尔谢赫正式成为曼城的老板。

sentences.en: There is some debate within soccer as to whether the club's ultimate backer is in effect the state of Abu Dhabi.
sentences.zh: 足球界内部对于该俱乐部的最终金主实际上是否是阿布扎比国存在一些争论。

sentences.en: But either way, the amount of wealth that Sheikh Mansour can call on distorts the economics of European soccer.
sentences.zh: 但无论如何，曼苏尔谢赫所能调动的财富扭曲了欧洲足球的经济学。

sentences.en: What does it mean functionally when a club is bought by one of these rich owners?
sentences.zh: 当一家俱乐部被这些富有老板之一收购时，从功能上讲这意味着什么？

sentences.en: When you have golf states, for example, being able to support some of these big teams, how does it distort the economics of the sport, as you said?
sentences.zh: 当你有海湾国家等能够支持其中一些大球队时，正如你所说，这如何扭曲了这项运动的经济学？

sentences.en: It gives a club a wealth that none of its rivals can match.
sentences.zh: 它赋予了一家任何竞争对手都无法比拟的财富。

sentences.en: Because soccer works on this kind of completely unregulated free market, there is in effect no real ceiling on how much you can pay in terms of salary.
sentences.zh: 因为足球是以这种完全不受监管的自由市场运作的，在薪酬方面实际上没有真正的上限。

sentences.en: There are no checks and balances in the system as there are in the United States, where there's a draft system.
sentences.zh: 系统中没有像美国那样存在选秀制度的制衡机制。

sentences.en: So if you're terrible, you will get access the following year to potentially the best pick, the best player of the forthcoming generation.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你表现糟糕，第二年你将有机会获得最好的选秀权，也就是未来一代最好的球员。

sentences.en: There is a way of ensuring a degree of competitive balance.
sentences.zh: 有一种方法可以确保一定程度的竞争平衡。

sentences.en: Europeans don't do any of that in soccer.
sentences.zh: 欧洲人在足球中根本不搞这一套。

sentences.en: None of that exists.
sentences.zh: 这些都不存在。

sentences.en: It is dog-eat-dog.
sentences.zh: 这是一个弱肉强食的世界。

sentences.en: So what we've seen in the last 20 years is an agglomeration of the best players in the world at just a handful of clubs.
sentences.zh: 所以我们在过去20年里看到的是，世界上最好的球员聚集在少数几家俱乐部。

sentences.en: That there are maybe 12 teams, give or take, who have squads that are stuffed full of international stars, paid eye-watering sums of money.
sentences.zh: 大概有12支左右的球队，他们的阵容里塞满了国际巨星，拿着令人咋舌的巨额薪水。

sentences.en: They are the envy of the world.
sentences.zh: 他们是全世界羡慕的对象。

sentences.en: And they give these super clubs this incredible strength in depth, which enables them to compete even further.
sentences.zh: 他们赋予了这些超级俱乐部令人难以置信的阵容深度，使他们能够进一步竞争。

sentences.en: Was there a backlash or reaction from fans when these changes were happening?
sentences.zh: 当这些变化发生时，球迷们有产生强烈的反弹或反应吗？

sentences.en: One of the really interesting things about the transformation in soccer in the last 30 years has been that basically every step of the way has been cheered by fans.
sentences.zh: 过去30年里足球变革中真正有趣的事情之一是，基本上每一步都受到了球迷的欢呼。

sentences.en: To a fan, the soccer team is not its owners.
sentences.zh: 对球迷来说，足球队不是它的老板。

sentences.en: It's not its players.
sentences.zh: 它不是它的球员。

sentences.en: It's not its manager.
sentences.zh: 它不是它的经理。

sentences.en: There is a spiritual ownership, I guess, an emotional contract between the fans and the team where the team is a badge, a feeling, a conversation you had with one of your parents,
sentences.zh: 我想有一种精神上的所有权，球迷与球队之间存在着一种情感契约，球队是一个队徽、一种感觉、你和父母有过的一次谈话

sentences.en: something you share with your friends, something that makes you who you are, that doesn't have any connection to the people who wear the shirt on the field
sentences.zh: 你与朋友们分享的事物，塑造了你独特自我的事物，这些与那些在场上身披球衣的人毫无关系，

sentences.en: or the people who run the club in the background.
sentences.zh: 也与在幕后运营俱乐部的那些人无关。

sentences.en: So as long as new owners have arrived and brought with them a higher quality of player, greater power in the transfer market,
sentences.zh: 因此，只要新老板们的到来带来了更高水平的球员、在转会市场上拥有更强大的话语权，

sentences.en: a big, brash, bold vision for where this new team can go, the passion that Manchester City fans feel for their team is, if anything, unchanged by the fact that it is fair to say
sentences.zh: 并为这支新球队的未来规划了一个宏大、张扬、大胆的远景，曼城球迷对他们球队的热情不仅没有改变，而且可以说，

sentences.en: it is now a PR exercise for Abu Dhabi.
sentences.zh: 它现在成了阿布扎比的一场公关活动。

sentences.en: And that was true of most of the fans of all the teams who had outside investment, and it's also true of Premier League fans in general.
sentences.zh: 拥有外部投资的所有球队的大多数球迷都是如此，英超球迷总体上也同样如此。

sentences.en: Everyone was so dazzled by the big money signings, by the major trophies, by the glamour of the whole exercise that nobody ever really stopped to ask, why is this money here,
sentences.zh: 每个人都被重金签约、顶级奖杯以及整个事件的光环所迷醉，以至于从来没有人真正停下来问一句：为什么这笔钱会在这里，

sentences.en: what does it want, and where is this all going?
sentences.zh: 它想要什么，这一切又将走向何方？

I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.

sentences.zh: 罗里，你说过在过去的几年里，巨额资金彻底改变了足球的动态，现金的大量涌入确实改变了这项运动

sentences.en: at its kind of fundamental and basic level.
sentences.zh: 在某种根本和基础层面上的面貌。

sentences.en: It seems as if there was an open question of how far that sport and its 100-year traditions and history could be pushed.
sentences.zh: 似乎一直有一个悬而未决的问题：这项运动及其长达百年的传统和历史究竟能被推向多远。

sentences.en: And did we kind of get an answer to that this week?
sentences.zh: 我们这周是不是得到了这个问题的答案？

sentences.en: It seems like we did.
sentences.zh: 看来我们确实得到了。

sentences.en: Yeah, I think we did.
sentences.zh: 是的，我想是的。

sentences.en: So on Sunday, we started to hear rumors that some sort of major announcement was coming.
sentences.zh: 因此，在周日，我们开始听到传言称将有什么重大宣布。

sentences.en: My colleague, Tarek Panja, who kind of stalked the dark and murky corridors of power in sports, called me kind of Sunday lunchtime and said that he was expecting something,
sentences.zh: 我的同事塔里克·潘佳（Tarek Panja）一直在体育界黑暗而浑浊的权力走廊里打探，他在周日午餐时间左右打电话给我，说他预料会有事情发生，

sentences.en: that something was brewing, that chaos had kind of broken out among executives and owners.
sentences.zh: 有什么事情正在酝酿，高管和老板们之间已经爆发了一场混乱。

sentences.en: And then, just before midnight European time, he was proved right.
sentences.zh: 然后，就在欧洲时间午夜之前，事实证明他是对的。

sentences.en: We do want to fill you in on a story that is breaking across the football world right now.
sentences.zh: 我们确实想向大家通报一则目前正轰动整个足球界的新闻。

sentences.en: Twelve of the biggest, most important clubs in the world put out this strangely basic and undetailed statement.
sentences.zh: 世界上十二家最大、最重要的俱乐部发布了一份奇怪的、极其简陋且缺乏细节的声明。

sentences.en: And it's a statement leading European football clubs announce new Super League competition.
sentences.zh: 这是一份欧洲顶级足球俱乐部宣布全新超级联赛竞争的声明。

sentences.en: They had concocted a plan to launch what they called the Super League.
sentences.zh: 他们精心炮制了一个计划，发起他们所谓的超级联赛。

sentences.en: Manchester City, United,
sentences.zh: 曼城、曼联、

sentences.en: Liverpool, Chelsea, Spurs, Arsenal, Real Madrid.
sentences.zh: 利物浦、切尔西、热刺、阿森纳、皇家马德里。

sentences.en: The 12 teams that had signed up to this plan,
sentences.zh: 签署了这项计划的 12 支球队，

sentences.en: EC Milan and Juventus, included some who had traditional European ownership, but also those who had American and Russian and Gulf State backing.
sentences.zh: AC米兰和尤文图斯，其中既有一些拥有欧洲传统所有权的球队，也有得到美国、俄罗斯和海湾国家支持的球队。

sentences.en: The clubs involved, the amount of money we're talking about, this feels real.
sentences.zh: 涉事的俱乐部，我们所谈论的资金数额，这一切让人感觉是认真的。

sentences.en: These owners had been meeting in secret to devise this new lead in which each of their teams would be granted a permanent place in the competition.
sentences.zh: 这些老板们一直在秘密开会，设计这个新的联赛，其中他们的每一支球队都将在该赛事中获得一个永久席位。

sentences.en: Big, big, big questions now about what is going to happen.
sentences.zh: 现在关于将要发生什么，存在着巨大、巨大、巨大的疑问。

sentences.en: But the elite teams already play each other consistently now in what's called the Champions League.
sentences.zh: 但是精英球队现在已经在所谓的欧冠联赛中不断地彼此交锋了。

sentences.en: So why is the Super League different than what the Champions League already is?
sentences.zh: 那么，超级联赛与现有的欧冠联赛有什么不同呢？

sentences.en: Partly because of the permanence that the 12 founding members agreed to give themselves.
sentences.zh: 部分原因在于这 12 家创始成员国同意赋予自身的永久性。

sentences.en: The sense that no matter how bad they were, how badly they performed, their place was secure.
sentences.zh: 那种无论他们表现多糟糕，他们的席位都是稳固的感觉。

sentences.en: You have to qualify to be in the Champions League.
sentences.zh: 你必须获得资格才能参加欧冠联赛。

sentences.en: You have to qualify every single year to be in the Champions League.
sentences.zh: 你必须每年都获得资格才能参加欧冠联赛。

sentences.en: And if you don't qualify, you miss out on all of the money and all of the glamour.
sentences.zh: 如果你没有获得资格，你就会错失所有的金钱和所有的光环。

sentences.en: That's kind of how soccer is meant to work.
sentences.zh: 这正是足球本来应该有的运作方式。

sentences.en: That sense of having to earn your place is central to soccer's self-identity.
sentences.zh: 那种必须靠实力赢得席位的感觉是足球自我认同的核心。

sentences.en: And the other thing that was really a seismic shift with this new Super League was the sheer amount of money involved.
sentences.zh: 而这个新超级联赛带来的另一个真正意义上的巨大转变是所涉及的巨额资金。

sentences.en: The teams had a debt facility with JP Morgan, the investment bank, that they said would enable each team to receive a $400 million stipend just for joining.
sentences.zh: 这些球队与投资银行摩根大通签订了一项债务融资协议，他们称这将使每支球队仅凭加入就能获得 4 亿美元的津贴。

sentences.en: And the revenues the Super League would generate, both in terms of broadcast deals and commercial, would dwarf anything on offer, not only in the domestic leads,
sentences.zh: 超级联赛将产生的收入，无论是在转播协议还是商业方面，都将使国内联赛中提供的任何东西相形见绌，

sentences.en: but in the Champions League too.
sentences.zh: 在欧冠联赛中也是如此。

sentences.en: That would, in one fell swoop, effectively make the elite unchallengeable from anyone else.
sentences.zh: 这将一举有效地使精英阶层免受任何其他人的挑战。

sentences.en: As someone who is a fan of the Premier League and a fan of a team that was signed up for the Super League, I was shocked on Sunday at the announcement, seemingly because it came,
sentences.zh: 作为一名英超球迷以及一支签署了超级联赛的球队的球迷，我在周日的公告发布时感到震惊，原因似乎在于它就像

sentences.en: as you said, out of whispers and secrecy.
sentences.zh: 你所说的，是从窃窃私语和秘密中诞生的。

sentences.en: What was the fan reaction across Europe when the clubs made this announcement on Sunday?
sentences.zh: 当俱乐部在周日发布这一公告时，全欧洲的球迷有何反应？

sentences.zh: 这是耻辱！

sentences.zh: 绝对的耻辱！

sentences.en: Disgusting!
sentences.zh: 太令人作呕了！

sentences.en: From the fans, the reaction was one of blind and outright fury.
sentences.zh: 球迷们的反应是盲目而彻底的愤怒。

sentences.zh: 同意加入这个超级联赛的每一个俱乐部都应该被关进监狱！

sentences.en: And initially, of course, that spread on social media.
sentences.zh: 当然，最初这在社交媒体上蔓延开来。

sentences.en: La morte del calcio per come lo conosciamo attualmente.
sentences.zh: 这是我们目前所知的足球的死亡。

sentences.en: As it became clear that this thing was real.
sentences.zh: 随着事情明朗化，这一切都是真的。

sentences.en: Seriously, you have got to stamp on this.

sentences.en: This is a...

sentences.zh: 然后到了周一，我们看到了对此的第一次真正的抗议。

sentences.zh: 参与该计划的球队之一利物浦在客场对阵利兹联，数百名球迷聚集在

sentences.zh: 利兹联的体育场外，一个名为

sentences.en: To the ESL for God!
sentences.zh: 为了上帝的超级联赛！

sentences.en: To the ESL for God!
sentences.zh: 为了上帝的超级联赛！

sentences.en: But the outrage among the fans of the teams involved was possibly greater even than the outrage of the fans of the teams who'd been left behind.
sentences.zh: 但涉事球队球迷的愤怒，甚至可能比那些被抛下的球队球迷的愤怒还要大。

sentences.en: On Tuesday, when another of the teams involved, Chelsea, played a home game against Brighton, the road outside their stadium had to be closed because of the number
sentences.zh: 周二，当另一支涉事球队切尔西在主场迎战布莱顿比赛时，他们体育场外的道路不得不关闭，因为聚集了大量

sentences.en: It seems as if what you're saying is that some of these fans,
sentences.zh: 看来你的意思是，其中一些球迷，

sentences.zh: 利物浦球迷，

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.zh: 足球迷之间存在着某种程度的集体利益，尽管你对你所支持的球队有着首要的忠诚，但对于整个比赛，对于那些永远没有机会参加欧冠联赛、但理论上可能会凭借其成为开放式比赛而达到最高峰的几十个小球队，

sentences.en: The 12 breakaway clubs, the problem they had was that their place in the Super League, the thing that would generate all of the money, was secure in perpetuity.
sentences.zh: 这被视为对支撑俱乐部足球的基本原则之一的背叛，我认为所有派系、所有俱乐部的球迷，包括那些涉事的球迷，都本能地知道
